title: Atlas local runtime retained Exe water-evidence registration and qualified retrieval integration
uncertainty: Can the maintainable local registration/publication/retrieval workflow accommodate a third disconnected region with native reference, event and monthly observation evidence, without forcing it into two-region terrain or calendar-year semantics?
why: Unified retrieval is adequate for the present49 source selectors/32 scalar products. Its real limitation is finite two-region adapters and year-qualified source evidence. Existing accepted Exe water/temporal proofs already establish qualified native geometry, monthly detection/non-detection/no-observation and dated event/reference distinctions using retained offline bytes. Moving that supported population into the runtime adds genuine geography, physical evidence and temporal capability rather than another index optimisation.
prerequisites: this unified runtime retrieval workflow and accepted source/derivation/publication contracts
unchanged retained Exe31 source/document receipts,66 files and accepted water/temporal proofs
source-specific local-research rights and qualifications rechecked against retained records before registration
explicit bounded support EPSG:27700[295000,86000,298500,89000], with P1[296600,86550,296800,86750]; no new acquisition
permittedScope: use accepted native readers and evidence contracts through a narrow runtime adapter for WFDGB510804505600,RFO31383/group4124 and March/September2024 P1 point/support evidence
register actual retained reference/event/monthly source/prepared identities, native support, provenance, rights and honest unknowns through library/CLI
extend coherent component membership and generation-pinned qualified retrieval only as needed for this third region and month/event/reference predicates
demonstrate old/new histories, current-region isolation, catalogue rebuild and failure/restart recovery
retain existing accepted methods; any native-code counts are accepted summaries with exact support, not new physical inference
deliverable: One documented maintainable runtime workflow that registers and retrieves the bounded retained Exe water population alongside unchanged Tryfan/Riffelhorn, with source-qualified time/geometry and coherent historical publication.
acceptance: source identities/current bytes/support/rights agree with accepted native receipts; no fabricated observation or acquired dataset
reference, flood-event footprint and monthly detection meanings remain distinct; no-observation/non-detection/absent evidence/physical absence remain distinct
indexed qualified results agree with independent retained native/full-scan oracles including actual March0/0/77 and September76/1/0 P1 counts where selected
existing Tryfan/Riffelhorn source and derived identities/qualifications remain unchanged across regional registration
staged/invalid/incomplete evidence remains unpublished; pinned old/new generations and fresh replay/rebuild are coherent
library/CLI workflow, actual cost/storage and finite coverage limitations documented
accepted evidence/contracts/statuses/production protections and relevant tests/types/lint/build pass
stop: Stop after this bounded third-region native-evidence workflow is implemented, verified, documented, committed/pushed or a precise blocker established. Do not broaden Exe, acquire products or begin a subsequent task.
